None of these are present in the building's available streams, which contain only the single zone temperature sensor, the cooling/heating setpoints, and the damper-position setpoint — insufficient to tell a genuine temperature/load rise apart from a positive sensor fault.

I have confirmed the store holds only a single redundant-free zone temperature sensor plus setpoints/damper-setpoints — no second temperature sensor, no occupancy/load stream, no VAV flow/damper-actual stream for Zone_F3_Z01. A sustained, step-like rise in the only available temperature stream is indistinguishable between a real temperature (load) increase and a positive sensor offset, because both produce the identical signal and there is nothing independent against which to cross-check it.

input.needed_streams: A second/redundant zone air temperature sensor independent of Zone_F3_Z01.Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor (to cross-check a sensor offset); a local load/occupancy indicator for the zone e.g. Zone_F3_Z01 electric power sensor, occupancy sensor, or illuminance; and measured VAV_F3_Z01 air flow / damper position (actual, not setpoint) showing air-side control action. None of these are present in the building's available streams, which contain only the single zone temperature sensor, the cooling/heating setpoints, and the damper-position setpoint — insufficient to tell a genuine temperature/load rise apart from a positive sensor fault.
